text.실행 중인 에이전트가 공유 메모리를 읽고 쓰게 하고 그 기록을 남긴다: Lets running agents read and write shared memory and records what they do
Server administrator settings for limits on the memory tools agents use during runs.
text.실행 하나에서 에이전트들이 메모리에 쓸 수 있는 최대 횟수입니다. 넘으면: Maximum number of memory writes the agents in one run can make. Above it, the write tool fails with rate_limited and the run continues. Leave empty for no limit.
text.에이전트가 메모리를 너무 많이 쓰거나, 긴 실행에서 쓰기가 막힐 때 바꾸: Change this when agents write to memory too much, or when writes get blocked in long runs.
text.에이전트에게 공유 메모리 도구(검색·읽기·쓰기·지우기)를 주고 범위마다: Gives agents shared memory tools (search, read, write, delete) and sets permissions per scope.

codes.memory.access_invalid: The merged memory access settings don't match the expected shape, so memory tools aren't given
